## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The new status line should be fixed to show the same revision identifier as the history and completion output: `status` truncates to 7 characters where they use 12, contradicting its own docstring, and the added test does not check the revision.

## Changes
The pull request adds `status(revision, attempt)` and `attempt_label(attempt)` to `app/display.py` to render a `Running: <revision> (attempt N)` line, plus a module-level `REVIEW_HINT` string constant. It adds two tests in `tests/test_display.py` for the status prefix and suffix and for the attempt label.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the 12-character revision in `status` — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status` returns `Running: 0123456 (attempt 2)` while `history` returns `History: 0123456789ab`. The docstring on line 13 says "Show the deployment revision using the same identifier as history", but line 14 slices `revision[:7]`; the added test asserts only the prefix and suffix. — Operators cannot match a running deployment's status line to its history or completion line by exact revision string. — Fix: Slice `revision[:12]` as `app/display.py:5` does, and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to assert the whole line.
